# 00000002857

**AS-27 ★** — source: 80_代数统计与张量分解的几何.md

**English.** Definition: Phylogenetic invariants: the algebraic characterization of evolutionary trees. Conjecture: Completeness of phylogenetic invariants: the ideal of the tree cluster is generated by quartet invariants plus lock-chain invariants, and the minimal generating set corresponds to the set of internal edges of the tree. (phylogenetic invariant complete set)

**中文。** 定义：phylogenetic 不变量：进化树的代数刻画。猜想：系统发育不变量的完备性：树的簇的理想由四次不变量加锁链不变量生成且生成的最小集对应于树的内部边集合。（系统发育不变量完备集）
